$comment: Plan 8.3: prompts and normalization rules are frozen before the held-out collection is processed for the first time. This file is that freeze, and evaluation/src/freeze.test.ts enforces it: change any constant below without changing this file and the suite fails. Editing a value here to make the test pass is not a fix, it is a new freeze, and it invalidates the generalization claim unless the held-out set is rerun. Re-frozen once: NORMALIZATION_VERSION moved to normalize@2 when generic subjects ("document", "this presentation") were scoped to their own document, after merging them across files produced a false contradiction between two filing dates. The generalization run under normalize@1 was throttled and produced no measured accuracy, so nothing measured is invalidated by this; a future generalization claim must be made under normalize@2. Re-frozen again: EXTRACTION_PROMPT_VERSION moved to claim-extract@2 when the collection's predicate registry began being shown to extraction, after measurement found 1,053 distinct predicates across 1,991 claims and only two (entity, predicate) pairs shared between documents — leaving cross-document retrieval nothing to match on. Re-frozen a third time: CHECKS_VERSION moved to checks@2 when a context dimension stopped counting as different where only one document stated it. corroborates requires zero context differences, so treating silence as disagreement had blocked every deterministic corroboration in the collection.
